intro: In Duskwood, Burning Rock smolders in the depths of Roland's Doom. Gutspill, leader of the Nightbane worgen, carries it, and Grimand Elmore in Stormwind needs it with fiery worgen blood to forge enchanted armor for promising warriors.

p: Gutspill carries Burning Rock through the shafts of Roland's Doom. Grimand Elmore in Stormwind wants its heat for armor made with fiery worgen blood. He is testing smithing techniques developed by his peer Furen Longbeard, to make tough plates for veteran fighters.
